lines.zh: 我四翅分开扇，悬在一人高处
lines.en: Four wings beat apart; I hover at head height.
My beat is slow, but the wings are loud.
I glide a stretch, then beat again.

lines.zh: 七十厘米的翼展，在草上投下影子
lines.en: A seventy-centimeter span shadows the grass.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面飞，找小东西
lines.en: I fly low over the water, hunting small things.

lines.zh: 我停在芦苇上，芦苇弯了一点
lines.en: I perch on a reed; it bends a little.
My four wings offset as I turn.
I go from one clump of grass to the next.

lines.zh: 我的复眼很大，几乎占满头
lines.en: My compound eyes are huge, filling most of my head.
When the wind rises, I settle.
I fly steadier than I look.
I patrol back and forth along the stream.

lines.zh: 我的翅上有网一样的纹
lines.en: My wings carry a net of veins.

lines.zh: 我在高处停了一下，看清了地势
lines.en: I pause high up and read the land.

lines.zh: 我一扇翅就换一个方向
lines.en: One beat and I change direction.

lines.zh: 我的腿垂着，抓不住大东西
lines.en: My legs hang down; they cannot grip much.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，你没察觉
lines.en: I pass over your head and you never noticed.
I return to the same twig.
I rest on a twig, wings spread flat.

lines.zh: 我的翅薄得能看见后面的光
lines.en: My wings are thin enough to show the light behind.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候像一片枯叶
lines.en: Still, I look like a dead leaf.
I groom my forewing.

lines.zh: 我的头能转很大的角度
lines.en: My head turns through a wide arc.
The water glints below.
I wait for something to fly past.

lines.zh: 我是石炭纪留下来的样子
lines.en: I keep the shape of the Carboniferous.

lines.zh: 空气里的湿度我很敏感
lines.en: I am sensitive to the damp in the air.
My wings quiver once and still.
I stare at a patch of empty air.
I carry no stinger

lines.zh: 我悬在你面前，翅还在扇
lines.en: I hover before you, wings still beating.
You are far too big to be prey.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪头，复眼对着你
lines.en: I tilt my head, compound eyes on you.
I drift back half a foot.
I am only looking; I will not eat you.
Your hand sweeps; I rise.
A few small insects drift between us.
Can you hear my wings?
I settle on a nearby twig.

lines.zh: 我一抖翅就离开了枝头
lines.en: One flick of my wings and I leave the branch

lines.zh: 我翅声乱了，往下坠了一点
lines.en: My wingbeat breaks and I drop a little.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的翅撕了一道
lines.en: That tore a slit in my wing.
I do not cry out; I only fly off.
I settle and hide under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我的四翅只剩三翅好用
lines.en: Only three of my four wings work.
Flying costs me effort now.
I shake my wings, and fragments fall.
With this wound, I cannot fly far.
I cling to the twig, trying not to move.
I try to rise again.
A small insect; I see it.

lines.zh: 我不吃这个，我只吃活的
lines.en: I do not eat that; only living things.
I have circled twice above you
Your hand holds nothing I want.
I come lower to look.
These few insects are enough.
I cannot grip anything large.
Stand still; I am working out the distance
I lunge once and miss.
I loop once and settle back on the branch
You touched me and I tumbled once.
A small tear in my wing.

lines.zh: 我掉下去一点，又飞起来
lines.en: I drop a bit, then recover.
That sent me off course.
I weigh too little to move you
I go around you and settle again.
My wingbeat lost a beat.

lines.zh: 我停在你的影子里缓一下
lines.en: I rest in your shadow to recover.

lines.zh: 被碰到我就得重新落位
lines.en: A touch and I have to settle again
I rise a bit, away from you.

lines.zh: 我们这样的，天上才见面
lines.en: Things like us only meet in the air.

lines.zh: 两只一起飞，翅声会合上
lines.en: Flying together, our wingbeats align.
My wings are a little broader than its.
We circle above the water.
I need a steady patch of water weed.

lines.zh: 我们不落地，就在飞的时候
lines.en: We do not land; we do it in flight.
My kind do not fight each other.
It settles, and so do I.
The reeds by the water can hold us both.
The day is short; make it count.

lines.zh: 我用腿抓了一下，抓不牢
lines.en: I grab with my legs; it will not hold.
It is heavier than I am.

lines.zh: 我叼起来飞了两下，掉了
lines.en: I lift it, fly twice, and drop it.
I land on it and try to move it.
I cannot take this.
I glide while hugging it with my forelegs.
It fell into the water.
I perch beside it and look.
This weight is too much.
I give up and fly off.
A small insect is flying.
My compound eyes lock on it.
I rise a little to take position.
It cannot escape my line.
I am patient; it must land eventually.
That is not prey; too large.
I shift around into the backlight
Movement in that direction.
My four wings accelerate.
That one.

lines.zh: 我在它上方绕，等它慢下来
lines.en: I circle above it, waiting for it to slow.
When it turns, I cut it off.

lines.zh: 我在逆光的位置，它看不见我
lines.en: I am between it and the light; it cannot see me.
I chase low over the water.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一直响，但它听不出方向
lines.en: My wings sound, but it cannot place them.
Half a meter still.
I have its landing point.
The wind helps me, and it.
I make no cry; it would flee.
Half a foot closer and it is mine
I dive, legs reaching first.

lines.zh: 我用翅把它的方向打乱
lines.en: I beat my wings to spoil its course.
Caught.

lines.zh: 我的颚很小，咬不了大东西
lines.en: My mandibles are small; they cannot bite much.
I pin it against a leaf.
I missed, and it fell.
I rise again and search anew.
I eat only the small, not the large.
My wingbeat stops suddenly.
I return to the twig to eat slowly.

lines.zh: 我停在芦苇上，先抖了抖翅
lines.en: I settle on a reed and shake my wings.

lines.zh: 这里的空气很湿，正合适
lines.en: The air here is damp; just right.

lines.zh: 我的翅先展开，才飞起来
lines.en: I spread my wings before flying.

lines.zh: 水面上方有足够的小虫
lines.en: There are enough small insects above the water.
My shadow crosses the water.
I fly up from downstream.
Only I and the small insects are here
My compound eyes adjust to the light first.
I look around once from above.
I settle a while to rest.
My wingbeat is conspicuous in this wood.
I find a steady leaf.
Fire touches me and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我掉到地上，翅上沾了土
lines.en: I hit the ground, dirt on my wings.

lines.zh: 水面合上了，我挣不出来
lines.en: The surface closes; I cannot break free.
The blast scatters all my wings.
An arrow tears through my wing.
That force pins me in midair.

lines.zh: 没有小虫，我飞得越来越慢
lines.en: No insects; my flight grows slower.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我什么都看不见
lines.en: A flash of lightning and I see nothing.
No air left; I fall.
